positioning: Proof over promises. Local-first software with receipts, honest claims, and user-owned workflows.

availabilityTaxonomy.derivation: Availability is about the product, not its newest build lane: a product is AVAILABLE when release.publicVersion names a current public release, even while a newer candidate is also in flight. WITHDRAWN means the former public release was withdrawn and no current public download exists. NO_PUBLIC_RELEASE means no public release of the product exists yet.

products.releaseNote: Current download: Cache Vault v0.3.1 for Windows. This release adds phone-side capture to the Android companion: copies made on the phone save from the persistent Save last copy notification or when you next open the app, screenshots import automatically, and a sensitive auto-block (on by default) refuses password-, key-, token-, and card-looking clips. Android grants no app background clipboard access, so nothing is captured silently while another app is in front. Companion v0.3.1 is release-signed (certificate SHA-256 c2eb5c42a684326ceba1289e65e9690ed71daf770de64e2b83a42bce04026a2c) and published on GitHub Releases and Proof Foundry downloads. The Windows build is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch; verify the SHA-256 before running it.

products.releaseNote: Lights Out v11.1.3 is the current public Windows release, published 2026-09-15 from release source commit 5f8ede7. The shipped artifacts — the Windows installer EXE and the portable ZIP — were qualified by three consecutive Reality Gate runs on that exact source identity (receipts 342c11bc-d2d6-4918-8920-a495211ff69b and 6323d762-859a-4385-91d7-923cd1bc1610, plus pre-publication run adff2359-3350-4d6d-9e04-74c295003c58; all PASSED, receipt-verified), then hash-verified after upload. Public downloads are served from the Proof Foundry mirror alongside a published SHA256SUMS.txt; a GitHub release record exists but anonymous access is blocked. These are unsigned Windows builds — not Authenticode-signed. The earlier RC4-candidate qualification (receipt 6b67a712-33ba-4cd6-9c4a-81e66f056750, artifact SHA-256 c7872350...) covered superseded candidate bytes and is retained only as historical evidence.

products.releaseNote: Public release v0.4.0 (Windows). Unsigned by Windows — not Microsoft publisher signed, not SmartScreen trusted. The release was verified with 188/188 tests passing, a clean build, and packaged runtime qualification (13/13 steps). v0.4.0 adds multi-select batch workflow (select, Commit Selected, Discard Selected), keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+A, Escape, Shift-click range), tray status tooltips (staged/modified/conflict counts), and safer commit routing that prevents renderer-supplied destination redirection. The tray Discard All bypass has been removed. Verify the SHA-256 before running. Windows SmartScreen may prompt on first launch — choose More info, then Run anyway.

products.releaseNote: Public release v0.3.5 (Android APK). Adds Ask ForgeCast (deterministic weather-decision answers with evidence, no cloud chatbot), condition- and timing-aware Wear/Bring clothing guidance, dynamic decision widgets (Best Window, Wear/Bring, rain and cooling changes ahead, honest stale state), a forecast-aware Ask discovery strip with screen-reader support, and Samsung OneUI widget reliability (native cached-bitmap restore after reboot or background freezing). Upgrading from v0.3.4 keeps settings and data (verified on device); upgrading from v0.3.3 or earlier requires uninstall/reinstall. Served via Proof Foundry distribution; the same bytes are attached to the v0.3.5 GitHub release.
